attributes.name: ypy-dedupe
attributes.description: Set to `false` on an element to keep its GET requests out of the sharing of identical requests that are in flight. Write `ypy-dedupe:inherited="false"` on a container to do it for everything inside.

values.name: false
values.description: This element's requests are never shared.

events.name: ypy:dedupe:joined
events.description: Fires on the source element when its GET request joined an identical request that was already in flight, so only one request goes to the network. `waiters` counts the requests that wait for it, this one included.

config.name: dedupe
config.description: Settings of the sharing of identical GET requests.

config.name: dedupe.ignore
config.description: Names of the request headers that do not make two requests different (compared without regard to case). Every other header must be equal for the requests to be shared.
